scheme_name: Distribution of Minikits At Free of Cost
other_conditions: Resident of any of the specified districts of Tamil Nadu: Coimbatore, Dindigul, Erode, Dharmapuri, Krishnagiri, Namakkal, Perambalur, Virudhunagar, Theni, Villupuram, Vellore, Salem, Pudukkottai, Madurai, Sivagangai, Trichy, Tirunelveli, and Thoothukudi.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy for free distribution of minikits to eligible maize‑growing farmers.
